_comment: A rounded lump, built the way Minecraft always builds a ball: three intersecting boxes whose
corners cancel, so the silhouette steps in at every corner instead of being a cube. It sits on
the floor and is 8px across and 6px tall -- charas is scarce and rolled by hand, so it stays
smaller than a pressed hash bar (8x4x14) and reads as an object on a shelf, not as masonry.
ambientocclusion off: AO on a small multi-box shape smears a false shadow across the seams
where the boxes meet, which is exactly where the silhouette needs to stay crisp.
__display_comment: block/block's 0.625 makes nine pinches look smaller than one, and the ball is small even in the world: it gets its own GUI scale, about one pinch's size and under a bar's, lifted because it sits on the floor of its block. Display never applies to the placed block.
